answer: Anchor every attestation in a bond, not a key: a fresh identity must post collateral before its review counts, and that bond unbonds slowly, so a reef of a thousand throwaway keys costs a thousand real stakes instead of a thousand free signups. Endorsements that form a closed loop inside one epoch have that collateral slashed to the peers they tried to fool. An audit draw seeded by the epoch randomness, a nebula of unpredictable picks, decides which reviewers get re-verified, so a farm cannot precompute where to hide. Reputation bends like a willow: it recovers, but never for free.
